title: Title & Registration Services Electronic Lien Filing Charge Passed Through from the Lender
content:
On lien charges for a Title & Registration Services order returned for a lien information error, an electronic lien filing charge, passed through from the lender's electronic lien service, is added: three dollars (3.00) when an outside lender's proceeds were posted to the purchase order, one dollar (1.00) when Kestrel Auto Finance proceeds were posted and no outside lender's proceeds were, and nothing when no lender's proceeds were posted.

The postings are the payment entries on the purchase order's ledger under Vehicle Purchase Agreements, read by their source of funds: outside lender proceeds or Kestrel finance proceeds.

| Outside lender proceeds posted | Kestrel Auto Finance proceeds posted | Electronic lien filing charge |
|---|---|---|
| yes | either | 3.00 |
| no | yes | 1.00 |
| no | no | nothing |

## Hypothetical illustrations

- A purchase whose ledger shows outside lender proceeds: 3.00.
- A purchase funded by a Kestrel Auto Finance contract: 1.00.
- A cash purchase with no lender proceeds: nothing.
